description: No mechanism exists to restrict processing of personal data when applicable conditions are met, such as during accuracy verification or when processing is contested.
applicability: Applicable when data subjects request restriction under Article 18 conditions. Must be able to limit processing while retaining data.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of data processing controls and restriction capabilities. Verify ability to flag and limit processing of specific data records.
